messages:
sophie: Quick heads-up — audio tech just reported an intermittent hum on Stage 2 mic. Moving leadership Q&A to slide 3 and pushing start to 2:05pm so we can swap gear.
aj: Okay, do we need to pause the livestream or can we hot-switch to a backup feed?
ops-bot: Recorder 2 health: degraded. Initiating standby recorder spin-up (recorder-3).
kevin: On it — I'll patch R2 -> R3 and flip the RTMP. @devstreams, please prep the backup endpoint.
devstreams: Preparing backup RTMP endpoint now. ETA ~45s, will announce when live.
maria: Suggest we open Q&A to chat while we switch so leadership can triage written questions.
sophie: Good idea. @jordan can you compile the top 5 roadmap Qs to prioritize?
jordan: On it — posting in ~2m with ranks.
leo: Tech note: if recorder-3 stays idle after start, run `sudo systemctl restart recorder-backup` — it sometimes needs a restart to clear the encoder hang.
kevin: Feed mapped, doing a quick level check and sync.
devstreams: Backup feed is live. Expect a very short blackout (~3s) at the switch.
aj: Confirmed audio & video on backup feed. Slight delay ~2s vs primary but acceptable for live Q&A.
sophie: Thanks team. We'll start the Q&A at 2:05 on the backup feed. Leadership, please queue up on Stage 1 cam when ready.
maria: I'll capture incoming chat Qs and mark the top ones for leadership. Will add follow-ups to All-Hands notes.
ops-bot: Recording resumed on recorder-3. Session ID: RH-2485-3.
kevin: Quick ops suggestion for follow-up: include `stage` and `fallback` tags in hot-switch recording filenames for easier post-processing.
sophie: Agreed. Post-mortem follow-up: ops to write a short runbook for this scenario. Assigning @kevin and @leo.
jordan: Q list posted in thread: 1) model rollout timeline, 2) Dedicated capacity pricing, 3) Private deploy roadmap, 4) SLO changes for latency, 5) hiring update for infra.
sophie: Perfect — we'll cover the first three live and capture the rest in the follow-up doc. :thumbsup:
aj: Thanks everyone. I'll update the All-Hands doc and spin up a follow-up thread for action items.
